about: CausalScribe automatic-check rules (Feature API v1 and Mode API v2). The server (scribe_checks.py) and the kit's cs-check read this same data; scribe-kit/rules.json must stay byte-identical (tests/test_scribe_checks.py). Patterns are written for both Python re (ASCII mode) and JavaScript RegExp; flags: i = ignore case, m = ^ and $ per line.

all.message: bidirectional control characters can make code read differently from how it runs
control characters are not allowed in text files

script.message: network calls are not allowed (fetch)
network calls are not allowed (XMLHttpRequest)
network calls are not allowed (WebSocket)
network calls are not allowed (EventSource)
network calls are not allowed (navigator.sendBeacon)
loading code is not allowed (importScripts)
network calls are not allowed (WebRTC)
network calls are not allowed (WebTransport)
workers are not allowed
remote addresses are not allowed in scripts (put links in the README)
navigation is not allowed (location); rename any variable called location
opening windows is not allowed
eval is not allowed
the Function constructor (new Function) is not allowed
setTimeout and setInterval must be given a function, not text
modules and dynamic import are not allowed: one plain script
reaching the Function constructor through .constructor is not allowed
write letters, digits and punctuation as plain characters, not as escapes
decoding hidden text (atob, unescape) is not allowed
use ordinary spaces in scripts
cookies are not allowed (document.cookie)
keep notes with CausalScribe.store, not localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB or caches
talk to the game only through CausalScribe (no top., parent. or opener.)
talk to the game only through CausalScribe (no postMessage)
no computed property access on window, self, globalThis or document
scripts may not contain or build <script> tags (no <script src>)
<!-- is not allowed in scripts (it can end the script's tag)
iframe, object, embed, base, meta, link and form tags are not allowed
creating script, iframe, object, embed, base, meta, link, form or a elements is not allowed

style.message: url() may only use data: (remote and relative addresses are not allowed)
remote addresses are not allowed in styles
</style and <!-- are not allowed (they can end the style's tag)
CSS that runs code (expression, behavior, -moz-binding) is not allowed
write plain characters instead of CSS escapes

modes.about: Mode API v2 (manifest kind "mode", api "2"). Scoring rules are the whitelist the server implements (scribe_modes.py); each param is [min, max, default, "int" or "num"]. pack names the server-side puzzle pack (scribe_mode_packs.json) and must be of the kind the rule reads. scene and moves are the runtime limits hostcore.js applies (LIMITS); tests keep them equal.

moderation.about: Copies of the server's claim_intake patterns (links, e-mail addresses, phone numbers). The blocklist itself is server-only (CLAIM_BLOCKLIST).
